verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for https://developers.openai.com/llms.txt, a documentation index that explicitly covers Plugins and Codex. A second probe confirmed Markdown versions of the docs pages (e.g. codex/skills.md), which link back to an llms.txt index. The cited plugin and skill docs are themselves served as .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed straight at them. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs successfully, and any plugin-specific agent-oriented guide beyond the general index.
